articles.title: Anti-ICE protesters attack federal vehicle, threaten agents in Oregon parking lot; video shows
articles.summary: Anti-ICE protesters in Oregon, USA, attacked a federal vehicle and threatened agents in a parking lot, with video evidence circulating. This incident underscores the escalating tensions surrounding immigration enforcement policies and public demonstrations within the United States, reflecting challenges to law and order and civil liberties in a prominent global democracy.

articles.title: PM Modi stresses State-led development, says empowering States is key to Viksit Bharat
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently stated that empowering individual states is fundamental to India's overall development and progress. He stressed that the nation's growth depends on enabling states to achieve their aspirations. This approach reinforces the concept of cooperative federalism, ensuring that strengthening regional capabilities directly translates into national prosperity and a more robust India through decentralized progress.
